title: Three Shots Ahead
style: Soft rock with orchestral swells and nature textures, mid-tempo swung groove; verse rides warm acoustic guitar, brushed percussion, and subtle strings; pre-chorus strips to piano and airy pads; chorus opens with soaring high female vocal doubles and layered harmony; ear candy includes wind-chime accents, distant birds, and a reverse string swell into each lift; mix is soft, wide, and glossy with intimate close-mic verses, soft rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I walked in thinking speed would win
A quick wrist snap, a harder grin
But every bounce began to say
This little court wants more than sway

The ball kept asking, what’s your plan?
Can you think farther than your hand?
Can you wait for the open lane?
Can you turn pressure into gain?

[Pre-Chorus]
Three shots ahead
I hear it now
Three shots ahead
I slow right down
One step back
To take the throne
I win this point
With head and bone

[Chorus]
Play it with your head
Not your strength
Play it with your head
Win by length
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
I only strike
When it’s dead

[Verse 2]
I used to chase the shiny smash
And give away the easy cash
Now I let the weak ball drift
And save my swing for the perfect gift

A soft reset, a patient slide
A little shape, a little time
I move like branches in the breeze
And make the whole side bend to me

[Pre-Chorus]
Three shots ahead
I see the line
Three shots ahead
I wait for mine
Not every shot
Deserves my name
I pick my moment
I play the game

[Chorus]
Play it with your head
Not your strength
Play it with your head
Win by length
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
I only strike
When it’s dead

[Bridge]
The fastest hand can miss the room
The smartest one can watch it bloom
I read the court like rings in wood
And know when good is really good

So let them rush, let them lean
I’ve got a calm they haven’t seen
I build my points like stones in rain
And let the right one break the frame

[Final Chorus]
Play it with your head
Not your strength
Play it with your head
Win by length
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
I only strike
When it’s dead

Three shots ahead
I breathe and see
Three shots ahead
The court in me
I wait, I place
I let it spread
And win the day
From in my head
